Synthetic CV, created for OTH-115; no real person's data.

`resume.doc` is a real Word 97 file exported by LibreOffice from the HTML below.
The DOCX and PDF were exported from that DOC in LibreOffice. Keeping the real
binary fixtures catches reader, worker, encoding and deployed base-path failures.

```html
<!doctype html><html><head><meta charset="utf-8"></head><body>
<h1>Jana Nováková</h1><p>Frontend Developer</p>
<p>React and TypeScript. Docker and GraphQL.</p>
<p>Experience building accessible applications.</p></body></html>
```
